heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: 那个～『再见了肱二头肌』！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_001
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: 啊哈哈，那拜拜啦～

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_002
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: 啊，辛苦了！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_003
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: 其实，聊天也是可以变成歌的哦！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_004
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text:
对吧！？……对了！
小律，我们一起唱吧！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_005
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: 简称《魔法露露》。这里考试会考哦～

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_006
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text:
我是仲町阿拉蕾！
梦想是和大家用歌声聊天！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_007
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text:
能去各种各样的地方，
用歌声和大家一起聊天！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_008
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text:
然后啊，逐梦镇的人们的肱二头肌
啪～地亮起来了！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_009
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text:
啊～呃～《魔法的物理攻击☆酷露露》……
简称《魔法露露》。这里考试会考哦～

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_010
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: 和我一起唱吧！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_011
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text:
我也知道光道歉是不够的！
所以如果有什么能用来赔罪的事，我什么都愿意——

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_012
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: 首次演出辛苦啦～！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_013
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: 这就是『梦限大MewType』！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_014
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: 我要办演出！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_015
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: 有有有有有！吉他！！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_016
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text:
我跟你说！我把聊天的话写下来，就变成歌词了！
重大发现！天才！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_017
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text:
大家好！
我们是『梦限大MewType』！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_018
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text:
我想把至今为止以及今后的心情！
都写进歌词！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_019
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: 啊——呜——啊——♪啦啦啦～♪

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_020
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: 哇——得快点，不然到场者限定特典就没了！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_021
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: 大家怎么还不来啊～好期待练习啊～

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_022
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: 下次的翻唱，唱首关于樱花的歌也不错呢～！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_023
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: 我心目中传说的春季动画10选！……根本选不出来啦～！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_024
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: 呜～好热，要化掉了～

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_025
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: 烟花大会上要放《魔法露露》的歌！？必须去现场看！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Name: voice_026
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.Text: 读书之秋推荐搭配Chupa&Sachu！！
